fusions.name: Pestle Draw
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Mortar Grind
fusions.desc: Pounds the ground, dealing 12 poison damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning them for 1 second and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bitter Rebound
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, each affliction laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

fusions.name: Spent Dose
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions lifts, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
